full_details: At the church porch Master Thwaite turned the sand-glass twice, said he would be brief, and named three days to the ashes. You paid sixpence for firing and washing till Lady Day. Sir John Spencer sat three rows ahead and did not turn. Mistress Ansell had the heel of the loaf in her hand, a penny and a finger short, and said she would not salt the house ahead of the church. Alse asked which hunger was hers. You left Gib on the Ovid. In the afternoon you took Friday's leaf from the folder, read the one line, and put it back. You did not add a title, a number, or a name, and you did not give it to anyone. At the Bull the sharers had a chine, mustard, marrow-bones, and double ale at tenpence a head. Nashe came uninvited, talked most of the evening, sang one verse, and paid a penny for one cup. Heminges touched the table. You left close on nine.
one_sentence: You heard three days to the ashes, put one old line back in the folder, and left the Bull close on nine with the purse hurting.
title: Three days to the ashes, and the Bull
